description: Small graded-relevance fixture proving the registry supports a second dataset with a different judgment_type, with no runner code changes.

records.question: Why is LocalRAG described as offline-first?
records.reference_answer: Because documents, models, and computation all stay on the local machine — no data leaves the host to answer a query.

citations.text: LocalRAG is an offline-first RAG system. Your documents, your models, your machine.
It uses Chroma as the vector store and Ollama for embeddings and LLM inference.

records.question: What does hybrid retrieval mode combine?
records.reference_answer: Hybrid mode combines dense vector similarity search with BM25 keyword search, merged via reciprocal rank fusion.

citations.text: Hybrid retrieval merges dense (Chroma) and sparse (BM25) candidates using reciprocal rank fusion (RRF).
